summary: Testing completed for Features 3, 4, 6, 7, 8: Video Consultations (Daily.co), Insurance Platform, Gamification (Health Streaks), Smart Wearables (Google Fit), Mental Health Support. All 30 backend API tests passed after fixing leaderboard bug. All 5 frontend pages load correctly with proper UI elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Video Consult uses real Daily.co API - room creation works with DAILY_CO_API_KEY
Insurance has 9 Indian providers (Star Health, HDFC Ergo, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa, Care Health, Bajaj Allianz, Tata AIG, LIC, Other)
Gamification leaderboard had KeyError bug - FIXED by adding phone field validation
Wearables supports 6 data types: steps, heart_rate, sleep, calories, distance, weight
Mental Health has 5 breathing exercises and 3 Indian crisis helplines (Vandrevala, iCall, NIMHANS)
All pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Test policies, claims, mood entries, journal entries, wearable data created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Features 3,4,6,7,8 fully tested. Video Consult creates real Daily.co rooms. Insurance has 9 Indian providers. Gamification check-in may show 'already checked in' for activities tested today. Mental Health has mood tracker (1-5), 5 breathing exercises, journal, and Indian crisis helplines.

features_tested.feature: Video Consult page (/video-consult) loads with hero, start button, join input, how-it-works
features_tested.details: Page loads with 'Talk to a Doctor Now' hero, Start Video Consultation button, join link input, Join button, 3-step how-it-works section, HIPAA Secure/HD Quality/Chat Support badges

features_tested.feature: Video Consult API: POST /api/video-consult/create-room creates a Daily.co room and returns room_url
features_tested.details: Returns room_url (daily.co URL), room_name, consultation_id, expires_at. Real Daily.co API integration working.

features_tested.feature: Insurance page (/insurance) loads with policy/claims tabs and summary stats
features_tested.details: Page loads with Policies/Claims tabs, summary stats (Policies count, Coverage amount, Pending claims), Add Policy button, File Claim button

features_tested.feature: Insurance API: GET /api/insurance/providers returns 9 Indian insurance providers
features_tested.details: Returns 9 providers: Star Health, HDFC Ergo, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa, Care Health, Bajaj Allianz, Tata AIG, LIC, Other

features_tested.feature: Insurance API: POST /api/insurance/policy creates a policy, GET /api/insurance/policies/{phone} returns it
features_tested.details: Policy creation returns policy_id, policy_number, sum_insured, premium. GET returns all policies for phone with total_coverage.

features_tested.feature: Health Streaks page (/health-streaks) loads with streak card, activities, badges, leaderboard tabs
features_tested.details: Page loads with streak count, Day Streak label, Best/Points/Badges stats, Activities/Badges/Leaderboard tabs

features_tested.feature: Gamification API: POST /api/gamification/check-in records activity and returns points/streak
features_tested.details: Returns points_earned, current_streak, longest_streak, new_badges. Supports 7 activities: steps, water, sleep, exercise, meditation, medicine, checkup

features_tested.feature: Gamification API: GET /api/gamification/profile/{phone} returns streak, badges, today's activities
features_tested.details: Returns current_streak, longest_streak, total_points, badges (8 total), today_activities, activities definitions

features_tested.feature: Wearables page (/wearables) loads with connection status, today's metrics, manual entry
features_tested.details: Page loads with 'No wearable connected' status, Connect button, Today section, Log manually button, manual entry form with data type dropdown and value input

features_tested.feature: Wearables API: POST /api/wearables/sync records manual health data
features_tested.details: Supports 6 data types: steps, heart_rate, sleep, calories, distance, weight. Returns data_type, value, unit, goal, goal_met

features_tested.feature: Mental Health page (/mental-health) loads with mood tracker, breathing exercises, journal, resources tabs
features_tested.details: Page loads with Mood/Breathe/Journal/Resources tabs, mood question with 5 mood buttons (Very Low to Great), breathing exercises, journal input, crisis helplines

features_tested.feature: Mental Health API: POST /api/mental-health/mood logs mood (1-5 scale)
features_tested.details: Accepts mood 1-5, returns mood value and label (Very Low, Low, Okay, Good, Great). Validates mood range.

features_tested.feature: Mental Health API: POST /api/mental-health/journal creates journal entry
features_tested.details: Creates entry with entry_id, title, content, mood, created_at. Returns saved entry.

features_tested.feature: Mental Health API: GET /api/mental-health/breathing-exercises returns 5 exercises
features_tested.details: Returns 5 exercises: Box Breathing, 4-7-8 Breathing, Anulom Vilom, Kapalbhati, Deep Belly Breathing. Each has inhale/hold/exhale durations, cycles, benefit, level.

features_tested.feature: Mental Health API: GET /api/mental-health/resources returns crisis helplines and self-help resources
features_tested.details: Returns 3 categories: Crisis (Vandrevala Foundation, iCall, NIMHANS), Self-Help (Thought Journal, Gratitude Practice, Progressive Relaxation), Wellness Tips

features_tested.feature: Home page (/) regression check - loads correctly
features_tested.details: Nevika Cura branding visible, DiaGyn/Mango/Orange links present, all main navigation working

bugs_fixed.issue: GET /api/gamification/leaderboard returned 500 error due to KeyError: 'phone'
bugs_fixed.fix: Added phone field validation in query filter and safe access with .get() method
